WITH 
-- Filter candidates that are in the IN-RJ region (Deeg is in IN-RJ)
candidates AS (
    SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT id, names."primary", subtype, region
        FROM divisions_area
        WHERE subtype = 'county'
        AND region = 'IN-RJ'
    )
),
-- Filter candidates within 25 km of Deeg (ST_Distance = 25)
within_25km AS (
    SELECT id, names."primary", subtype, region
    FROM candidates
    WHERE ST_Distance(ST_GeomFromText('POINT(0,0)', ST_GeomFromText('POINT(10,0)', 'POINT(10,0)')) AS geometry) <= 25
)
SELECT id, names."primary" AS name, ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geometry
FROM within_25km
ORDER BY id;

WITH DEBAGARH AS (
    SELECT id, names."primary" AS name, subtype, region
    FROM <CANDIDATES>
    WHERE names."primary" = 'Debagarh'
),
BORDERING AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT DEBAGARH.id, DEBAGARH.name, DEBAGARH.subtype, DEBAGARH.region
    FROM DEBAGARH
    JOIN ST_AsGeoJSON(DEBAGARH.geometry) AS geom ON DEBAGARH.id = geom.id
    WHERE geom.contains(geom)
)
SELECT id, name, subtype, region
FROM BORDERING;
